acceptance_criteria.observable: A clean checkout can install UI dependencies from the committed public npm lockfile, run typecheck and production build, and keep generated dependency/build outputs out of git status.

oracle.description: `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build:web`, and `git status --short` prove the contributor UI bootstrap and generated-output cleanliness.

constraints: Preserve unrelated user work and existing behavior outside the goal
non_goals: Do not redesign UI behavior, alter Signoff protocol gates, or add Python runtime dependencies.

requirements.statement: Make the contributor UI first-run install reproducible from the public npm lockfile without leaving generated dependency or build outputs untracked

stop_conditions: Stop or pivot when the goal cannot be proven within the iteration budget
